config.name: smokeX-H2S1X2K2-DEV0
config.note: smoke test of the step-2 ensemble (Amendment 3b item 5 fallback), M=2, 2 iterations, S3P DEV draw 0, the pilot's seed 524936564

step2_ensemble.seed_rule: member 0: step2.seed; member m >= 1: run_unfold.derive_seed(step2.seed, 'step2_ensemble', m); all per-fit seeds of a member from its seed by the predecessor's rules; the validation split is shared
step2_ensemble.weight_space: mean over members of the engine's per-member weight exp(clip(logit, -cap, cap)) (= f/(1-f) below the cap), accumulated avg += w_m / M in member order

distortion.name: dev
distortion.form: exp(A*clip((E-p50)/IQR, -Z, +Z)) / mean over the pseudodata's truth-passing rows

tilt_spec.name: dev
tilt_spec.form: exp(A*clip((E-p50)/IQR, -Z, +Z)) / mean over the pseudodata's truth-passing rows
tilt_spec.applied_on: pass_truth rows of the pseudodata only
